name: Fuyou Atsushi
source: Usually referred to by his childhood nickname, Atcchan. A boy far smaller than the rest of his peers, prone to feeling inadequate and anxious. He relates a lot to the struggles of the shy, self-conscious heroines in women's TV dramas. Has a very high pain threshold and finds scaldingly hot baths relaxing. May be something of a masochist.
